summary.text: Dom Belza is a Republican candidate for California State Assembly District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces fellow Republican James Johansson.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as farmer and businessman, and in a Ballotpedia survey he said he serves on the Marysville City Council.

paragraphs.text: In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Dom Belza described himself as a fourth-generation North State resident and an agricultural business owner from a generational farming family.

He said he has worked for 19 years as a local realtor and businessman, investing in and selling agricultural and commercial properties, and that he founded a conservative grassroots political action committee, Free California.
Belza advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary for Assembly District 3.
In the survey, he listed reducing the cost of living, supporting public safety, and preventing wildfires and protecting the North State's water sources as his key campaign messages.
